Name: Battle Seasoned
Description: While out of combat, you gain 1000 Health Recovery, and 250 Magicka and Stamina Recovery.

Name: Recoup Fortitude
Description: Gain 2000 out of combat Health Recovery.

Name: Calculating
Description: You gain a 10% experience bonus to Alliance Rank and Alliance War skill lines from all sources.

Name: Increased Experience
Description: You gain a 10% experience bonus from all sources.

Name: Increased Detection
Description: Increases your stealth detection by 15 meters.

Name: Efficient Repair
Description: You repair 50% more damage with repair kits.

Name: Siege Sight
Description: You can see the outlines of enemies while manning all siege weapons but rams.

Name: Spirit Mastery
Description: Decreases the time it takes to resurrect an ally by 25%.

Name: Light Foot
Description: Reduces the Movement Speed penalty of Sneak by 50% and the cost of Sneak by 20%.

Name: Sprint Adept
Description: Reduces the cost of Sprint by 20% and the movement speed bonus of Sprint by 10%.

Name: Bolster Running
Description: Increases the movement speed bonus of Sprint by 10% and the cost of Sprint by 20%.

Name: Swift Brace
Description: Increases your Movement Speed while Bracing by 100%.

Name: Extend Wells
Description: Increases the duration of your Ayleid Health Bonus by 1 hour.

Name: Soul Awakening
Description: Scholarly research makes your use of soul gems more effective. When resurrecting an ally with a soul gem, increase the Health they revive with by 50%.

Name: Heroic Resurrection
Description: You channel the heroic energies expended on the battlefield while reviving the fallen. When you resurrect an ally, both you and the ally gain Major Heroism for 15 seconds, gaining 3 Ultimate every 1.5 seconds.

Name: Courser
Description: You and your mount move as one, mirroring the skills possessed by the Gallants of Hammerfell. Reduces your Mount Sprint cost by 50%.

Name: Extend Wells
Description: The mantle of authority you've earned in Cyrodiil's theater of war rests easily on you, as if you were blessed by Saint Alessia herself. You count as an extra person for capturing objectives.
